prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
engine_stated_criteria: A good Phoenix starting point is Dr. Ariel Trujillo at Arizona Periodontal Group
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable single “best” dentist for everyone—implant needs vary, and online ratings alone don’t establish clinical quality. **A good Phoenix starting point is Dr. Ariel Trujillo at Arizona Periodontal Group**: he is a periodontist, and the practice lists American Board of Periodontology credentials and implant care. [Practice details and reviews](https://www.periodontistphoenix.com/)

For a second opinion, consider a **board-certified prosthodontist** if the case involves several teeth, a full-arch restoration, or a complicated bite; prosthodontists specialize in restoring teeth and implant-supported crowns. One Phoenix option listed is **Dr. Soo Cheol Jeong**, a board-certified prosthodontist at ClearChoice. [Provider profile](https://www.clearchoice.com/providers/soo-cheol-jeong/1154648079/)

Before choosing, ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, what training each has, whether a 3D scan and written treatment plan are included, and what the total cost and follow-up care cover. For a major or costly case, getting two consultations is sensible.
